invariants.statement: Supervisor is the sole final action-selection owner.
PlantCommitAdapter is the sole plant/dynamics commit owner.
A proposal has no commit authority.
C0 admission precedes L2 certification.
L2 PASS precedes every L3 witness attempt.
L1 is candidate-independent and computed once per cycle.
Each candidate receives a fresh attempt binding.
Synthetic alternatives are forbidden.
No V1 legacy combined geometry authority is loaded.
Controller operational radius remains 0.015 m.
Certification effective radius remains 0.025 m.
rho_seg remains 0.0 m.
Actuator violations are rejected.
No post-certification clipping is permitted.
Selected and executed action identities and vectors are equal.
A PREPARED token cannot execute.
At most one retained backup token is ACTIVE.
Backup-token handoff is atomic after successful navigation commit.
Backup cursor advances only after successful backup commit.
A backup tail is not an alternative candidate source.
A valid retained backup outranks terminal fallback.
Terminal certificate preparation is distinct from execution eligibility.
A zero vector does not determine ActionRole.
The assurance boundary performs no dynamics call.
Supervisor is the deadline policy owner.
No alternative search is started after deadline expiry.
ACTIVE_RUNTIME_ON requires an explicit RuntimeDeadlineProfile.
Goal-hold is disabled.
Runtime code cannot call a post-hoc outcome oracle.
A canonical trace lock is created before evaluation.
UNKNOWN is never silently converted to PASS.
Production and reference source remain untouched.
